budget_rule: Per layer/decode step identical total token-slot allowance INCLUDING fixed tokens. Floor to whole 16-token middle blocks. Distribute the same total middle-block quota using capped proportional native q=.95 budget counts (weight floor 1), largest remainder with head-index tie break. No answer-dependent calibration.
interpretation: Budget-renormalized S/A/B, not native unconstrained deployment. Equal useful slots per layer at matched sequence position; padding and generation lengths may differ.
metric: Official RULER string_match_all answer recall; also report all-required-answers hit rate, not exact match or precision.
prefill: Full causal prefill shared across methods, first output token shared; sparse from second output token. Chunked prefill if needed for memory, parity checked.
length_convention: Official RULER max_seq_length includes reserved generation tokens; no post-generation input truncation.
output: per-task/length quality vs useful and padded slot curves, paired bootstrap CIs and runtime, sample-size and full-score context
